beats.headline: Team Helix, three for one
beats.text: For the record: Rosetta brings in team Helix, a three-for-one mercenary squad that has raced two heats and placed first and second. A level 75 Grulke named Olga, a level 81 Porsuk named Finley, and the subject: a level 96 flaming fire fairy about Crawler Donut's size. Olga says the second place does not count. A demon with chains cheated, killing one of their two clients and their friend Helado. The subject speaks with a thick Spanish accent, worships Emberus, and has not taken her eyes off the bubbling Emberus shrine.

beats.headline: Triple the price, or walk
beats.text: She turns to Crawler Carl and changes her mind. It is not double the price. It is triple. Rosetta objects that the price has been negotiated and paid to the mercenary guild, and it cannot be raised after the fact. It is triple, the subject says, or they walk. Crawler Carl asks whether they drove in the last races. Finley and Olga can both drive; she is protection. Crawler Carl looks at her for a moment, and agrees to pay.

beats.headline: The unappeasable fire beckons
beats.text: Passing the temple to Club Vanquisher, she whispers that she had a vision. Their lord told her to help any fellow worshipper who was also a racer, and they are tasked with slaying his brother, Hellik: impossible, but they must try. She raised the price because she expects to be slain in the attempt, and the fee is to keep Olga and Finley safe for a while. She has already lost one friend. Her small hand on his shoulder sets his cape smouldering. Prepare yourself, brother. The unappeasable fire beckons.

beats.headline: She stops talking about Hellik
beats.text: In the village she rides Crawler Carl's shoulder, oblivious to what has just happened to him, giving him a pep talk about dying as a martyr. At the start line of the next heat she is hovering in the back of the truck, strangely depressed. Asked about Crawler Donut's singing, she manages a noncommittal squeak. She has stopped talking about killing Hellik. She keeps raising a finger as if to say something, then changing her mind. Crawler Carl suspects the conversation in the shop with Akuma: NPCs act differently after meeting one fully awakened.

beats.headline: Are you real
beats.text: On the start line, Crawler Carl feels heat on his shoulder. The subject is floating there, sobbing. Finley asks from the back whether Que is doing okay. She does not know what is real any more. Is this real? Is Crawler Carl real? Is she? Does any of it matter? Over the chat, meanwhile, Osvaldo is naming the god his second memorial crystal is for. Ahead, the floating traffic lights turn from red to yellow.

beats.headline: Doing this over and over
beats.text: In the truck it comes on suddenly, a full-blown panic attack, and the cab heats by the moment. Did Finley not hear what that elf mage said? Did nothing break in his small brain? It broke in hers. They have been doing this over and over. Olga explains, sheepish: a panic disorder. Their ice fairy, Helado, used to calm her. After the chain demon killed Helado, the subject killed one of their two clients, until Finley talked her down. Only one of them, Olga adds. She is better now.

beats.headline: Sleep now, friend
beats.text: Entering the forest, she babbles. She is not crazy. Or is she? What can she burn? She begs Emberus to show himself and speak to her and Crawler Carl. Finley grabs her out of the air in both hands. Stop, Fin, she says. Please stop. Let me end it all. He pokes her with one of his claws. Sleep now, friend, he says, gently, and Unconscious appears over her. He lays her carefully in the sink.

beats.headline: Carried into the street
beats.text: Quemada, fire fairy, is dead. She never woke. Finley regrets using so strong a sedative; she'll be mad he did not protect Olga. In town he carries the toad in his arms and the subject over his shoulder, on a scorched leather patch strapped to his jacket for carrying her while she is out. He is taking Que to a temple so she does not wake alone. He says they are his family. He steps into the street, and the APV of team One Fine Pig runs all three down, reverses, and runs them down again.

beats.headline: A scorch mark on the street
beats.text: Crawler Carl sits at the curb in front of what is left. Finley's legs are gone. Olga's head is caved in. The subject simply poofed out in a flare and left a scorch mark. Crawler Carl asks Crawler Donut to take the corpses, Finley and Olga at least; there is nothing of the subject to take. The crew cannot hire new mercenaries between heats. Crawler Carl sits there thinking how unfair it is: an NPC he barely knew, on his way to help his two friends, and all three snuffed out.
